text:
The Juniper planning meetings (3–10 Nov) set configuration and ownership for 25 modules. Final corrected values are: upload batch_size 200, billing 750, ledger 450, quota 900, export 350, session 250, metrics queue_depth 270, media 490, alerts timeout_s 20, and checkout ttl_s 360.

Fixed requirements are feed retry_limit 9, sync retry_limit 8, pricing retry_limit 6, and gateway batch_size 450. Ownership is reports and profile (gamma), alerts (beta), and metrics (delta).

Separation rules require checkout and sync, export and feed, catalog and shipping, and billing and checkout to run on different workers. Shipping and upload must share one worker.

Banned dependency paths are search→feed, sync→media, session→ledger, and archive→ingest.

Rollout order: metrics before reports, feed before scheduler, and quota before session.

Open items: the security review and the budget review, both next Thursday.
